Feeding routines, a plain notice after lunch
We write to travelers
Travel Notice for Companion Animals

Travelers should check their animal's documents and feeding plan before arrival at the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways. This helps our team prepare the right care and keeps the journey calm for everyone involved.

For reptile travel, the stated age rule applies. <<FACT F078>> Please also make sure the health certificate is ready for review before your animal is accepted for travel. <<FACT F084>> Our ground team handles carriers with care between services, and the crew follows the same safety checks each day.

We ask travelers to use sturdy carriers, keep water access sensible, and share any feeding notes or comfort needs with the desk when they arrive. Safety takes priority over speed in every journey, and clear papers help us move without delay. If you are traveling with more than one animal, please keep each set of papers together so the review stays smooth.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
